about_the_game:
What everyone can currently play is our first test version. Since it is still in the early stages of development, there are still many unpolished elements and bugs. We welcome all kinds of feedback.Here is a detailed introduction to the game:

"OMNIRING" is an infinite flow, multi-cycle, strategy role-playing game. Assemble a team of Samsarans, experience stories in vastly different worlds during continuous cycle adventures - battle, interact, make choices, resolve events... Train your team, step into the final battle, and become The detached.

Infinite Flow World, Infinite Possibilities

Swords, spears, sabers, and halberds of the Eastern martial world? Swords and magic of the Western fantasy world? The apocalyptic catastrophe with zombies everywhere? The vast expanse of stars and seas filled with spaceships? "OMNIRING" will offer you multiple worlds to choose from and experience, and may expand to 24 in the future (we have indeed planned for that many). They mean -

  • Diverse stories

    •   During this beta version, you will experience three distinct worldviews: Republican-era punk, Western fantasy, and biochemistry. In the full version of the game, you will ultimately be able to experience various types of stories - martial arts, xianxia, fantasy, science fiction, crime, comedy, Western, gangster, detective, horror, and strange tales...

  • Diverse Occupations

    •   Magic, Mystic Cultivation; Technology, Genetics; Divine Prayer, Divine Sin; Superpower, Meme. We have designed 8 power systems, each of which has various sub-branches of professions,such as necromancer, paladin, etc. within the magic system.

  • Diverse Enemies

    •   From Slime to Space Marines, the game will ultimately feature over 1,000 different enemies, including nearly 1,000 humanoid creatures and an equal number of monsters with unique models.

  • Free combination

    •   Each of your Samsarans can freely combine skills, talents, and equipment without being restricted by their own class

    •   Do you want to create a martial arts master who wields a pistol in the left hand, a staff in the right, and also uses internal martial arts skills? Sure, you can even have him transform into an avatar of a deity while firing floating cannons and sweeping across the battlefield.

Choose Your Own Story

  • Different scenarios and endings

    •   In each game, you will be able to choose one from multiple randomly selected scenarios to start your adventure.

    •   Each script will offer diverse endings and a story experience with choice branches.

  • Characters from different worlds

    •   Each Samsaran comes from various different worlds within the game, and each has their own unique experiences and relationships.

    •   These experiences will influence the direction of certain plotlines at appropriate times.

  • Personality Essence

    •   Each Samsaran belongs to a "Personality Essence," and the "projections" of the "Personality Essence" across all worldviews constitute Samsaran's counterparts.

    •   The Samsarans' Isotopes share some commonalities in personality or life experiences.

    •   Some Samsarans may be NPCs in certain worlds. Will you keenly spot them in the story?

Fight, but be cautious

  • A turn-based strategy game with simple operations

    •   Perhaps you're tired of turn-based strategy games where you have to move first and then select a target in each turn? In the battles of "OMNIRING", you only need to choose one action method per turn. This will reduce your operation volume by 50%, but you may need to get used to this way first.

  • Seize the room

    •   Battles in adventures will be presented in the form of room battles, and the styles of the rooms may be a car, a school, a battleship, or even a large crab.

    •   You can seize the rooms of some defeated enemies and use them as your own rooms.

  • Constructed Furnishings

    •   Your room has many display slots where you can place various furnishings - a Tesla coil? A ritual site that can summon a giant dragon? Or a human cannon that can launch your team?

Inherit, then become even stronger

  • Heritage Points

    •   After a round of the game ends, you will receive inheritance points.

    •   Either all members being killed or successfully completing the final challenge will end your current round of the game.

    •   By using inheritance points, you can unlock the Ring of Mobius, as well as abilities provided by several other wandering gods. This will make you increasingly powerful in reincarnation.

  • Ring of Möbius

    •   Want to try the feeling of having a "golden finger"?

    •   In "OMNIRING", the Samsaran Captain you recruit will automatically be equipped with the Ring of Mobius.

    •   Each Mobius Ring possesses a unique and powerful effect—such as the Soul-Binding Ring that can harvest enemies' souls to strengthen itself and the Fusion Ring that can "devour" teammates.

  • Stray Gods Buffs

    •   There are also five other Stray Gods in the game - Hela, Pablo, Scheherazade, Guigu, and Freud.

    •   They will also provide you with a completely different opening experience.

Planned updates

  • New choices brought by multiple playthroughs

    •   Each scenario will provide a complete achievement system, and completing an achievement may bring the following new content:

    • New inheritance unlock items

    • New available Samsarans

    • New available professions, skills, equipment, talents...

    • New alternative rooms that completely change the original narrative (when enough narrative variables accumulate, you will be able to achieve a new ending of the script)

    • and many other possibilities...

  • Creative Workshop Support

    •   We will provide developers with a complete set of power builder tools to facilitate everyone's entry into the universe of "OMNIRING"!

Contact Us

Official Feedback QQ Group: 1028055954

QQ Channel:pd41406352
